title: Should, Must, and So
label: ch:hi-should-must-and-so
canDo: I can say what someone should do (jānā cāhiye) and has to do (jānā paṛegā), join a cause to its result with isliye and to, and read and write ः in ataḥ.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-R281-advice-and-reasons: give advice, say what must be done, and draw the result.
